findings.evidence: packages/sdk/server/src/server.ts:153-158 — rec = sessions.get(); if undefined throw 'unknown session'; sessions.delete(); await rec.handle.dispose(); packages/sdk/server/src/server.ts:224-235 — getOrCreateSession reads only the live map and pending-creation map, with no closing-state guard; packages/core/agent/src/index.ts:482 — register() throws `agent "${id}" is already registered`, which surfaces as the new prompt's JSON-RPC error when publication races the old agent's unregister; both transports permit pipelining (packages/sdk/client/src/client.ts:340-372 concurrent request(); python/sdk/src/relay_harness/client.py:337-405 _request_raw waiter dict).
findings.fix_plan: Keep the record in the map until disposal completes: mark the record 'closing', route getOrCreateSession for a closing id onto a promise chained after the in-flight dispose (so a pipelined prompt waits and then creates the fresh session the contract promises), and only then delete the id. Alternatively serialize re-creation on the dispose promise inside closeSession before deleting. Add a server.spec.ts case: pipelined close+prompt for the same id resolves with a fresh agent rather than 'unknown session' or 'already registered'.
findings.risk: Serialization must not let a closeSession await an unbounded turn — dispose is quiescence-bounded abort, so the chain is bounded; the fake-handle spec pattern already covers deterministic ordering.
findings.summary: closeSession removes the id from the sessions map and then awaits rec.handle.dispose(). Because both transports allow pipelined requests, a client may issue session/prompt for the same id without waiting for the close response. Depending on interleaving, the prompt either (a) hits 'unknown session' while its own earlier creation is still pending, or (b) builds a second agent on the same SessionId whose publication races the old agent's unregister and fails with 'agent "X" is already registered'. Both contradict the documented close contract ('a later prompt for the closed id creates a fresh session') for a client pattern the protocol does not forbid; the failing side is loud but the contract is timing-dependent.
findings.test_plan: New failing-first packages/sdk/server/tests/server.spec.ts case using the existing fake-handle harness: resolve close's dispose with a deferred promise, issue prompt before releasing it, assert the prompt settles only after dispose completes and creates a fresh handle (no 'already registered'/'unknown session').
findings.title: server closeSession releases the id before disposal completes; pipelined prompt for the just-closed id can fail or race the registry

findings.evidence: packages/sdk/client/src/client.ts:57-67 — SdkProtocolError docstring example 'a `session/prompt` response without `accepted: true`'; actual check is `typeof result.messageId !== 'string'` (client.ts:313) and SessionPromptResult is { messageId } (packages/sdk/protocol/src/types.ts:41-45); matching stale comments at packages/sdk/client/tests/fake-runtime.ts:16-17 ('no accepted'); packages/sdk/server/src/server.ts:39-42 — 'Deployment-specific status mapping for SDK turn and subagent outcomes' while successStatus's only call site is the subagent.finished payload (server.ts:99) and packages/sdk/server/README.md:13 states it 'affects only the deployment-mapped status on subagent.finished; root-session prompts have no prompt-level status'.
findings.fix_plan: Rewrite the SdkProtocolError example to the real failure ('a session/prompt response without messageId'), align fake-runtime.ts comments, and narrow the HarnessSdkJsonRpcServerOptions JSDoc to subagent outcomes only (matching the README's wording). Pure comment change, no behavior edit.
findings.summary: Two SDK doc surfaces describe wire behavior that no longer (or never did) exist: (1) SdkProtocolError's JSDoc and the fake-runtime comments describe a `session/prompt` response checked for `accepted: true`, but the wire result is `{ messageId }` and the validation reads messageId; (2) HarnessSdkJsonRpcServerOptions claims its mapping covers 'SDK turn and subagent outcomes', but only subagent.finished statuses are mapped — root turns surface unmapped 'max-tokens' in RunResult.finishReason. Both mislead SDK consumers about error and wire surfaces on a protocol that just changed.
findings.test_plan: No runtime test needed; `pnpm run doc-sync` / lint JSDoc gates cover the edited files.
findings.title: Stale JSDoc contradicts the wire: 'accepted: true' prompt receipt and 'turn outcome' status mapping

findings.evidence: python/sdk/src/relay_harness/client.py:129-130 — `if self._closed: raise` executes before `with self._lock` (136-153) which owns the spawn; client.py:164-168 — close() sets _closed then snapshots proc; proc None → fail-waiters and return with no child teardown. TS equivalent is race-free: closeTask is memoized at entry (packages/sdk/client/src/client.ts:426-428) and start() rejects once it exists (client.ts:222), with the spawn synchronous inside start().
findings.fix_plan: Move the _closed check inside the spawn lock (re-validate after acquiring, mirroring the existing _proc re-check), and make close() either wait on an in-flight start or observe the spawned child after setting _closed (e.g. re-read _proc after the spawn critical section and tear it down). Simplest faithful mirror of TS: record a close-entered flag under the same lock the spawn uses, and have the spawn critical section abort itself if close-entered.
findings.risk: Low: lock scope widens over subprocess.Popen only; the concurrent-start test (test_client.py:1322) already exercises this critical section and guards regressions.
findings.summary: In the Python client, start() checks self._closed before acquiring the spawn lock, while close() sets _closed and then snapshots self._proc. If close() runs while a start() is between its closed-check and the lock, close() sees proc=None, fails waiters, and returns reporting a closed client — then start() completes the spawn. The resulting runtime child receives no shutdown request and no dispose ladder; it lives until externally killed while the client reports closed. The TypeScript twin cannot interleave this way (start() rejects on a memoized closeTask and spawns synchronously), so the shared 'close is terminal and reaps the child' contract holds on only one side.
findings.test_plan: Failing-first python/sdk/tests/test_client.py case: a launch_args script that blocks on a file marker before answering; start() on a thread, call close() after start passes its closed-check (gate via the marker), release, assert no surviving child process (proc.poll() is not None) and that a subsequent start() raises TransportClosedError.
findings.title: Python HarnessClient close-vs-start race can orphan a runtime; TS has no such window

audits.summary: Verified session/close end-to-end after R5-C/D: TS SDK specs 3 files / 80 tests passed; Python SDK pytest 83 passed. Protocol docs mention session/close on both ends (protocol/server/client READMEs + python/sdk/README.md) and the SessionCloseParams re-export is fixed. The R4-deferred RunResult/finishReason parity items landed on both sides (TS finishReason + SdkProtocolError validation; Python finish_reason with the data.content fallback removed). The prompt-then-close-immediately probe does NOT strand prompts: server-side dispose aborts the turn, agent-loop records turn/end {kind:'aborted'} (packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:416-432), the driver finally publishes idle (agent.ts:276-278) which crosses the wire as session.status idle (packages/sdk/server/src/server.ts:76-78), so both SDKs' run loops terminate with finishReason 'aborted'. Real seams found: the new close method has no real-runtime wire coverage anywhere (both snapshot/e2e harnesses pin only named sessions); neither SDK's keyless snapshot records finishReason despite it being the headline R5 parity field; server closeSession releases the id before disposal completes so a pipelined prompt for the just-closed id can violate the documented fresh-session contract ('unknown session' or 'already registered'); two stale JSDoc surfaces describe wire behavior that does not exist ('accepted: true', 'turn outcome' status mapping); and the Python client has a close-vs-start race that orphans a runtime, asymmetric with the TS memoized closeTask.

findings.evidence: 客户端截止与保留：packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/client.ts:228（DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS=30_000）、:424（prompt: callUnary('session.prompt', payload, signal) 默认 bounded 策略，仅 host.pickDirectory:441-443 例外）、:313-316（AbortSignal.timeout 与 caller signal 合并）；packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/machine.ts:593-596（release abort 在飞 attempt）、facade.ts:400-406（dispose abort image-only 直发；:215-216 注释声称"shell dispose aborts the in-flight Host round-trip"）、facade.ts:565-594（失败 settle 保留 draft/images，重试即重新 POST）；runtime 会把失败写入 promptError 横幅（packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/session.ts:242-248 + ui-conversation/skeleton/InputBar.tsx:95-102），但 host 侧无任何对账。host 侧不可取消且可变慢：packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/handler.ts:99（invoke: (api, r) => api.sessions.prompt(r) 丢弃 signal；对比 session.search:92、subagent.prompt:105 都转发）、packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/sessions.ts:380-386（SessionsApi.prompt 签名无 signal）、packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:1897-1938（admit 内 await durablePromptContent（落盘 base64 图片字节）后同步入 inbox，整段包进 serializeSessionOperation），:1665（selectModel 含 ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo/resolveCallConfig）、:2530-2554（agentPreset.select 含 presets.recompose 插件重挂载）共用同一 per-session 槽——R5-B 串行化把 prompt 的 admission 排队窗口拉长到可触达 30s。
findings.fix_plan: 1) 把 carrier signal 转发进 sessions.prompt（UNARY_ROUTES 行改为 (api, r, signal) => api.sessions.prompt(r, signal)，SessionsApi.prompt 增加 signal 参数），并只在提交点之前兑现取消：仍在 serializeSessionOperation 队列中排队、或 durablePromptContent 尚未开始时直接返回 code 'cancelled'，一旦开始落盘即照常 admit（admission 非 rolling）；2) composer 重试复用同一 rpcId 作为 UserMessage source.rpcId 已具备（request.rpcId 随消息持久化），host 可在 admit 前按 source.rpcId 幂等去重，杜绝 ghost 后的重试双投递；3) 若不做取消，至少修正 facade.ts:215-216 与 hub.ts 注释中"abort 即终止 round-trip"的错误前提，并让 promptError 文案表明"发送可能已送达"。

findings.summary: session.prompt 在客户端受 30s 默认超时与 attempt/dispose abort 约束，但 handler 丢弃 carrier signal、admission 又被 R5-B per-session 串行槽（可排在 selectModel/agentPreset.recompose 之后）拉长——客户端报失败并保留 draft，host 仍 admit 并开 turn，重试即双投递
findings.test_plan: 1) apiproxy 测试一（取消生效）：用 serializeSessionOperation 预塞一个 pending 槽，携带已 abort 的 signal 发 session.prompt，断言返回 code 'cancelled' 且 agent.inbox 无新消息；2) apiproxy 测试二（提交后不可取消）：durablePromptContent 完成后 abort，断言 ok 且消息已入 inbox（防止半途回滚造成 durable/不一致）；3) 幂等重试测试：同一 source.rpcId 二次 admit 断言第二条被拒/去重；4) 客户端测试：ui-conversation 现有 input-machine/facade spec 增补"超时 settle 后 draft 保留、再次 submit 使用相同 rpcId"断言。

findings.title: 发送管线把 live occurrence 表的 offset 拼接到 attempt 冻结的 draftSnapshot 上：机器在 adjudicating/submitting 期不拒绝 draft 变更，异步窗口内外部 setDraft 会把 reference 的 model form 拼错位置

audits.summary: 追踪 composer → sink → session.prompt（R5-B per-session 串行 admission）→ inbox → 会话事件回流 UI 的全链路后，确认 /api/respond 的 approval/question 流向、pending 表 replay 与并发去重两侧一致（packages/host/apiproxy/tests/client-handler.spec.ts 40 passed 复核），但发现 3 处两侧契约真实相悖：session.prompt 的 Service Definition 仍承诺 host 侧 slash 命令分发而实现完全没有（含死的 command 槽与两个不可达错误码）；prompt admission 无取消路径而客户端有 30s 强截止 + abort，失败方向两侧相反，超时/中止后 host 仍会 admit 造成 ghost 消息与重试双投递；以及发送管线用 live occurrence 表 offset 拼接 attempt 冻结的 draftSnapshot，机器在 busy phase 不拒绝 draft 变更。未修改任何文件。

findings.evidence: 生产顺序由 ConnectionController 固定：packages/client/connection/src/client/connection.ts:137-190 —— unary host.describe → `await this.callConnectedSink(...)`（onConnected 内部 await 全部 session.resync()，见 packages/client/runtime/src/client/index.ts:218-233）→ 之后才 `pumpStream(this.api.events.mux(...))`。因此：packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/session.ts:420-441 resync() 先把 `subscribedLastSeq = null`（:438）并同步 `await this.open()`，而补拉分支 session.ts:631-637（`if (this.subscribedLastSeq !== null && tailSeq !== null && this.subscribedLastSeq > tailSeq)`) 在此窗口内恒为 null——该分支只在「流已开、订阅帧先到、用户点击后才 open()」的懒加载路径可用。`session/subscribed` 帧到达后（session.ts:482-489）只回填字段、queueMirror.reset，没有任何尾检查；manager 侧同样没有（packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/manager.ts:739-760）。服务端事实：断流窗口内的事件不被重放——FrameQueue 预算触发的 end()（packages/host/apiproxy/src/frame-queue.ts:54-63，R5-B 新增强制断流）与 mux 重开后的基线循环（packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:2849-2951，`session/event` 监听器在基线 push 之后才注册，且重开只重放 subscribed/queue/jobs/pending 基线，不重放事件）。唯一兜底是 repairGap（session.ts:688-701, 712-728），它需要该会话之后还有新事件才会触发；若丢的恰是本轮最后的事件（如 turn/end 前的尾部增量/结果），会话窗口保持陈旧尾部直到下一次 prompt。两条注释与生产顺序相反：packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/session.ts:421-425（"onConnected … races the mux frames — the fresh generation's baseline may have landed already"）与 packages/client/runtime/src/client/index.ts:226-227（"reconnect replays flow from stream open, ahead of onConnected"）——实际顺序由 connection.client.spec 锁定（packages/client/connection/tests/connection.client.spec.ts:25-39，已运行 18 passed；packages/client/runtime/tests/wire-events.client.spec.ts:131 注释同样确认 hydration 先于 downlink）。这直接回答审计项一：R5-B 强制断流后重连+基线重放整体成立（WS close → pumpStream 正常结束 → 全量 re-baseline，packages/client/connection/src/client/web-api-client.ts:76-89），但为该窗口写的修复分支在重连路径上是死代码。
findings.fix_plan: 在 Session.handleMuxEnvelope 的 'session/subscribed' 分支补一次尾检查：openState==='open' 且 frame.lastSeq > windowTailSeq() 时调用现有 repairGap()（与 doOpen:633 同一谓词，复用 stitching 防重入）；或在 resync() 保留上一代 subscribedLastSeq 并在 doOpen 落窗后延迟到订阅帧到位再补检。同步修正 session.ts:421-425 与 runtime/src/client/index.ts:226-227 两条方向相反的注释，并在 frame-queue.ts 的保留契约注释里把"termination loses no state"改为"依赖客户端尾检查/补拉"。
findings.risk: 低：修复只作用于 openState==='open' 的重连补拉，懒加载首开路径行为不变；repairGap 已有 stitching 与 openGeneration 双重防陈旧。若选择"订阅帧先行"方案则需动 ConnectionController 的 sink 等待点，波及面大，不推荐。
findings.test_plan: packages/client/runtime 新增用例（session.client.spec 或独立 spec）：mock history 首拉返回尾 seq=N → handleMuxEnvelope 投递 session/subscribed(lastSeq=N+2) → 断言触发一次 tail-page 补拉且窗口含 seq N+1/N+2（现实现该断言为红）。反向用例：lastSeq <= tailSeq 不触发补拉。回归：`pnpm exec vitest run packages/client/runtime/tests/session.client.spec.ts packages/client/runtime/tests/sessions-service.client.spec.ts packages/client/connection/tests/connection.client.spec.ts`（当前分别 99 passed / 18 passed）。
findings.title: 重连基线缝：resync 路径的 subscribedLastSeq gap 补拉永不触发，断流窗口内丢失的会话尾部事件无守卫

findings.evidence: 广播侧对任意 key 无差别推送：packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:646-650 `sessionProjections.onChanged(... broadcast({type:'session/projection', key, ...}))`，而 sessionListMetadata 在 :654-663 注册（init {blank,lastPromptAt}，apply=applySessionListMetadata）——每次用户消息（lastPromptAt 变化）和 blank 翻转都会对每个 mux 订阅者各推一帧。消费侧：全仓 grep 无任何客户端读取 'sessionListMetadata'（客户端列表行的 blank/updatedAt 来自 host/session-added、host/session-status、user/message activity 帧，以及 refreshList 的 session.list 投影块：packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/manager.ts:486-492、823-831、711-720、1053-1055；该投影真正被消费的位置是 host 侧 session.list 组装，packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:1146 与 src/session-list.ts:51,95,140）。对照同文件内 imageLimits 的处理（api-proxy.ts:665-687：明确文档化"apply 恒等→永不 push，只由基线携带"），sessionListMetadata 缺少同样的 baseline-only 声明，形成同层不对称。为逐字段核对过的 R3-D 守卫在此补充佐证：这些帧即使被消费也不影响正确性（rowUnchanged 覆盖投影行的全部 13 个字段，packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/service.ts:188-202），属于纯粹的无效线束流量而非数据错误。
findings.fix_plan: 在 api-proxy 的 onChanged 广播处按 key allowlist 过滤：为投影注册增加 baseline-only 标记（镜像 imageLimits 的注释先例），sessionListMetadata 与 imageLimits 一并标注，广播跳过；或在 api-proxy README/key 表中明确声明该 key 的客户端消费面为空。改动限 api-proxy 一侧，客户端零改动。
findings.risk: 极低：广播只减不增；需确认没有第三方 SDK 客户端暗中消费该 key（消费面 grep 已覆盖 packages/ 与 apps/，python/sdk 不消费投影帧）。
findings.test_plan: packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-mux.spec.ts 增加断言：向已订阅 mux 的会话投递一条用户消息后，收到的 session/projection 帧集合不含 'sessionListMetadata'（改前为红）；保留现有 title 帧断言防止过滤过宽。回归：`pnpm exec vitest run packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-mux.spec.ts packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-projections.spec.ts`。
findings.title: host→client 投影帧不对称：sessionListMetadata 每次变更都广播给全部订阅者，但客户端零消费（列表元数据实际走 session.list）

audits.summary: 沿 api-proxy broadcast → FrameQueue(有界，可 END) → SSE/WebSocket → WebApiClient → ConnectionController → SessionManager/Session → projection store / ui-conversation 全链路核对。结论：帧词汇与字段两侧一致（session/projection、session/subscribed、session/queue、session/jobs 的字段与消费端读取完全对齐，higher-seq-wins 使投影 fold 对乱序免疫，R5-B per-session 串行化未破坏任何客户端顺序假设）；R3-D 的 rowUnchanged 守卫覆盖投影行全部字段（id 按 key 构造相等，manager 的 depth 不进投影行），未发现丢真变化的路径；FrameQueue END → WS 正常 close → pumpStream 结束 → 全量 re-baseline 的重连主链路成立。但发现一处真实对缝错误：客户端为重连窗口写的 subscribedLastSeq gap 补拉分支在 resync 路径上是死代码（ConnectionController 先 await onConnected 的全量 hydration、后开流，而 resync 把 subscribedLastSeq 置 null，订阅帧只能在开流后到达）——强制断流（R5-B FrameQueue END）后的重连正是走的这条路径；另有一处 host 单向广播了客户端零消费的 sessionListMetadata 投影帧。focused specs 已跑：connection.client.spec 18 passed、session/sessions-service 99 passed，均绿（说明缺陷是顺序性死角而非现有断言覆盖失败）。

Round-6 snapshot/e2e golden health audit. Ran 8 web/host lanes once each against the R3+R5 working tree (built libs from the 05:34 R5 build): built-boot.snapshot, details-session-lifecycle, seeded-history, composer-draft-scroll, question-composer, approval-composer (vitest.web.config.ts), plus frame-queue.spec and api-proxy-mux.spec. To separate new regressions from the documented pre-existing set (~106 lane fails, seeded-history x3, composer-tab-geometry x5), I built a HEAD-baseline git worktree (/tmp/rlh-r6-baseline, since removed) and re-ran the three ambiguous specs there, then bisected the one new failure inside the R5 apiproxy diff with surgical sandbox rebuilds. Verdict: exactly ONE new R3/R5-caused failure — details-session-lifecycle.e2e, caused by R5-B's per-session operation chain in packages/host/apiproxy (not by R3, not by the mux buffer cap). seeded-history reproduces its known pre-existing x3 unchanged; question-composer and built-boot failures reproduce identically at HEAD (pre-existing committed-chrome golden drift / stale spec assertion, not R3/R5); composer-draft-scroll, approval-composer, and both apiproxy host specs pass, so R3-C's input-shell lifecycle and R5-B's FrameQueue mux behavior itself are clean. Side correction: the memory note describes the golden-drift direction inverted — the committed goldens (ceb277f) contain the Trajectory tab / Select-model / Workspace-Write chrome, and it is the current served client that no longer renders them.

findings.title: R5-B per-session operation chain breaks seeded-session selection in the served web app (details-session-lifecycle e2e, new regression)
findings.evidence: Failing assertion: apps/web/tests/details-session-lifecycle.e2e.ts:146 `await page.getByText('DONE', { exact: true }).waitFor({ timeout: 15_000 })` — after clicking the runtime-seeded session treeitem, the seed row disappears from the sidebar 'Tasks' group and its conversation never mounts (failure screenshot: .artifacts/web-e2e-details-session-lifecycle.png in the removed worktree, reproduced identically in the main tree run /tmp/r6-web-batch1.log). Server side of the seam: packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:486 `serializeSessionOperation` (new in R5-B) now routes session.prompt admission (api-proxy.ts:1938), image resolveCallConfig (1665) and agentPresets.select (2554) through one per-session promise slot. Isolation: (1) HEAD baseline worktree (8cef, no R3/R5) PASSES the spec (/tmp/r6-baseline-web.log: 2 failed | 2 passed — details is the passing file); (2) HEAD + working-tree apiproxy src only FAILS 4/4 deterministically (main-tree run, /tmp/r6-hybrid-run.log, /tmp/r6-det-1.log, /tmp/r6-det-2.log) — R3 is exonerated, the causing changeset is R5-B apiproxy; (3) sandbox variants that bypass the serialization chain (all three call sites direct, /tmp/r6-hybrid-run5.log; or only the agentPresets.select site direct, /tmp/r6-hybrid-run6.log) PASS 1/1 each, while reverting only the cold-probe isAttached recheck (session-list.ts:136) still FAILS — so the serialization chain is the necessary cause and the probe recheck alone is not sufficient. FrameQueue muxStreamBufferBytes is exonerated (present in the passing builds). Client side: the selection flow the chain reorders is the seat-store staged-preset apply on current-session change (packages/client/ui-agent-preset/src/client/seat-store.ts:151-176) interacting with the serialized admission path; the precise wire call whose deferral drops the seed row is the one remaining unknown for R7.
findings.risk: Fixing by simply de-serializing reopens the TOCTOU races R5-B closed (concurrent prompt/preset-swap interleave); the fix must keep the slot for real admission races while not deferring (or must fail-fast) on the session-switch path — hence the two-sided test plan before choosing.
findings.fix_plan: R7: (1) reproduce with apps/web/tests/details-session-lifecycle.e2e.ts against a tree carrying only api-proxy.ts:486/1938/2554 hunk; (2) pin which serialized call starves the switch (capture the client→host RPC sequence during the seed click — likely the seat-store apply()/admission slot interaction on current-session change); (3) either keep the shared slot but settle the queued tail before session-switch reads (run switch-critical reads outside the slot), or scope the slot to admission-only routes (prompt/steer/queue) and leave agentPresets.select on its own chain as pre-R5; (4) keep the preset-swap blank re-check (the TOCTOU fix) independent of the routing change. Update the R5-B Agent Note with the regression.
findings.test_plan: 1) `pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.web.config.ts apps/web/tests/details-session-lifecycle.e2e.ts` must pass (it is the committed witness and currently fails 4/4 on R5 trees). 2) Keep packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-agent-preset.spec.ts (preset TOCTOU) and api-proxy-cold.spec.ts green to prove the original races stay closed. 3) Add an apiproxy-level test that a session.prompt admitted while a preset swap is queued still settles before a subsequent session.list/attach projection, mirroring the e2e sequence. 4) Re-run the deterministic pair from this audit: exact working-tree apiproxy (must now pass) and serialization-reverted control.

findings.title: Golden/lane verdict: no other R3/R5-caused failures; pre-existing drift set confirmed at HEAD baseline (and memory note direction corrected)
findings.evidence: At the R3+R5 tree: seeded-history.e2e.ts fails exactly its known pre-existing 3 tests (/tmp/r6-web-batch2.log: aria golden, Access-chip switch, feedback correlation row); question-composer.e2e.ts fails 1 golden compare and built-boot.snapshot.ts fails its `svg[viewBox="26 0 156 24"]` assertion (apps/web/tests/built-boot.snapshot.ts:45) — both reproduce IDENTICALLY at the HEAD (8cef) baseline worktree (/tmp/r6-baseline-web.log), so neither is caused by R3/R5. plan.strategy: R7 聚焦本轮四份审计中已证实的跨层契约相悖（front↔back wiring），全部经过仓库 file:line 复核，无推测项。排序原则：先修用户可见回归与静默数据丢失，再修契约死码与取消语义，最后收 SDK 侧一致性与线束卫生。同一文件的改动按序落盘避免冲突：api-proxy.ts 依次由 R7-A（:486/:2554 串行化路由）→ R7-C（:1897-1938 admit 取消点）→ R7-H（:646-663 广播过滤）触达，三者区域互不重叠且按此顺序执行；sessions.ts/schema 由 R7-C 独占；ui-conversation machine/facade 由 R7-D 独占；sdk/server/server.ts 由 R7-E 独占；SDK harness 快照由 R7-F 独占。R7-C 将 input-send-path 的两处 high（死 command 槽 + admission 无取消）合并为单一 seam slice：两者都改 session.prompt 这一条 wire route、共享 sessions.ts 与同一测试面（rpc-schemas/client-handler），拆开反而制造同文件排队。每片均 failing-first，验证命令聚焦本片 spec。已排除项：wire-events 的『订阅帧先行』重排 ConnectionController 方案（波及面大，采用 R7-B 的订阅帧侧补检）；R7-A 不做整段 de-serialize（会重开 R5-B 关闭的 TOCTOU）；R7-C 对 '/' 行不做 admission 拒绝（会误伤以 / 开头的真实提问），按 pre-release 立场直接删除死码并明文记录逐字入模语义。
